claim_ceiling: ACCEPTED (v3, v4) / REPRODUCED (v5 pending jurist evaluation)

direction_v3_legal_signals.corpus: 1,000 Swiss Federal Supreme Court decisions (2000+ slice), trilingual
direction_v3_legal_signals.baseline: debiased_citation_blended (n_pca=1, alpha=0.7) — 14/14 PASS validated in evaluation lane v1
direction_v3_legal_signals.key_finding: legal_cited_decisions_only ties baseline as general-purpose legal distance; legal signals improve legal classification but degrade multilingual/adversarial robustness; hybrids α=0.3–0.5 maximize legal metrics but fail language dominance

direction_v4_signal_ablation.harness: Validated fractal-map (hierarchical Leiden at res=0.5/3.0, zoom coherence)
direction_v4_signal_ablation.success_criteria: Frozen before observation: fine_purity > 0.850, improvement_rate > 50%, legal_area_NMI > 0.512
direction_v4_signal_ablation.signal_dilution: all_tfidf (6 signals) degrades fine_purity to 0.838 < baseline

direction_v5_pivot.scale_test: 1,200 decisions (not full 2000+); all v4 modes generalize; hybrid_erwaegungen_07 improves coarse (+0.039) + fine (+0.047); legal_issues_outcomes NMI=0.786
direction_v5_pivot.legal_embeddings: 3 models tested on 1,000 decisions: multilingual-e5-small (perfect cross-lang=1.0, lang_dom=1.034, zoom_impr=29%); xlm-roberta-base (zoom_impr=93%, coarse=0.490, lang_dom=1.002); paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (reference)
direction_v5_pivot.citation_roles: 2,988 annotations from 200 decisions (citing/following/criticizing/distinguishing/overruling); 6 role-specific 64-dim matrices; blocked by citation ID mismatch
direction_v5_pivot.jurist_evaluation: Complete protocol (200 questions, UI, sampling, analysis plan); NOT EXECUTED — needs 5-10 Swiss jurists, 600 responses
direction_v5_pivot.benchmark_refinement: 37 → 16 benchmarks (removed 4 redundant); Tier 1 Core: 7 (adversarial_language_dominance, jurist_pairwise_preference, jurivoc_l2_nmi, zoom_coherence_improvement_rate, citation_heritage_auc, legal_area_classification, scale_stability_frozen_pca)

audit_checks.leakage: None — unsupervised representations, frozen benchmarks, no metadata leakage except explicitly flagged legal_area_tfidf
audit_checks.non_discriminating_benchmarks: 3 diagnostic benchmarks (hierarchy_coherence, legal_area_clustering, zoom_coherence) produce identical results across all experiments — correctly excluded
audit_checks.weak_baselines: Baseline validated independently (evaluation lane v1, 14/14 PASS)
audit_checks.prettiness_as_quality: No — negative results (multilingual failures, overclustering, ID mismatch, unexecuted jurist eval) honestly reported
audit_checks.unsupported_claims: v5 'full corpus' = 1,200 not 2000+ (corrected in audit); embeddings tested on 1,000 not 1,200; benchmark refinement not yet validated as gate
audit_checks.negative_results_preserved: All failures (adversarial_falsification, multilingual_invariance, overclustering, signal dilution, ID mismatch) preserved in reports and raw data
